name: KpiCard
description: One headline number with its change and its trend, composing the @moderno-ui/react Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Skeleton and SparkChart primitives: the metric's label and period, its value in the display face, its change tinted by whether that change is good news and a sparkline of the period, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the value and the sparkline side by side at @sm, a larger value and a wider sparkline at @md, the widest sparkline at @lg.

examples.title: KPI card
examples.code:
import { KpiCard } from "@/components/blocks/kpi-card";

<KpiCard label="Revenue" period="This month" metric={{ value: "$48,200", delta: "+12%", tone: "positive" }} />

guidance.intent: One key number on a dashboard — its label and period, its value, its change and a small line of how it moved over the period.
guidance.whenToUse: A dashboard tile for one metric people check often: revenue, sign-ups, churn, open tickets. Put several in a grid for a dashboard's top row.
